description: Server-side inbox rules (destructive: covers `delete`; `dryRun` previews create/update). Rules run on the Exchange server whichever client is open. action=`list` (default) returns rules with id/name/sequence; `includeDetails: true` adds conditions/actions/exceptions. action=`create` builds a rule from condition params (12, e.g. fromAddresses, containsSubject, bodyContains, hasAttachments, importance, sensitivity), action params (9, e.g. moveToFolder/copyToFolder — folder name, nested path like `Triage/Delete`, or ID — forwardTo, redirectTo, assignCategories, markAsRead, delete) and optional `except*` exceptions. action=`update` patches fields by `ruleId` or `ruleName`. action=`reorder` changes priority via `sequence` (lower runs first). action=`delete` removes a rule. The recipient allowlist applies to forwardTo/redirectTo. There is no `permanentDelete` action. Changes count against the session limit (`OUTLOOK_MAX_MANAGE_RULES_PER_SESSION`, else `OUTLOOK_MAX_EMAILS_PER_SESSION`); 0 refuses them.

bodyOrSubjectContains.description: Comma-separated keywords matching body OR subject (OR logic) (action=create/update)

containsSubject.description: Comma-separated subject keywords (OR logic). e.g. "invoice, receipt, payment" (action=create/update)

copyToFolder.description: Folder to copy matching emails to: a name, a nested path like `Projects/Backup`, a well-known name, or a folder ID (action=create/update)

deleteMessage.description: Move matching emails to Deleted Items (action=create/update)

dryRun.description: Preview only (action=create or update): shows the rule without creating or changing it. Other actions refuse dryRun and change nothing. Default false.

exceptSenderContains.description: Comma-separated partial sender matches to exclude (action=create/update)

forwardTo.description: Comma-separated emails to forward matching messages to (action=create/update)

includeDetails.description: Include detailed conditions, actions, and exceptions (action=list)

moveToFolder.description: Folder to move matching emails to: a name, a nested path like `Triage/Delete`, a well-known name (e.g. `archive`), or a folder ID (action=create/update)

name.description: Rule name (action=create required, action=update to rename)

redirectTo.description: Comma-separated emails to redirect matching messages to (action=create/update)

sentCcMe.description: Match emails where I am in CC (action=create/update)

sentOnlyToMe.description: Match emails where I am the only recipient (action=create/update)

sequence.description: Execution order, lower = higher priority (action=create default: auto, action=reorder required)

name: manage-rules
title: Inbox Rules
